attributes.action:
Personal Tax Allowance 
Increase personal tax allowance
attributes.additional_details: Increasing the personal tax allowance would benefit millions of people’s pay packet. Not only did the government freeze our pay rise for years, they also froze personal tax allowance, which was a double whammy for the hard working people. The government needs to give something back. All we hear is how much more people on benefits will get and the migrant spend and situation is out of control and it’s disgraceful how the government are treating the British people. I have had to use food banks
attributes.background: I would like the government to increase personal tax allowance for the workers of Great Britain to be increased. As a full time NHS worker I am, along with millions of workers, struggling with all the rising costs & NHS pay is now stagnant

rejection.details:
The Income Tax Personal Allowance is currently £12,570. We're not sure how much you want the Government to increase it by.

You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Raise the Personal Allowance to £20K funded by a 2% tax on incomes over £100K
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777932

Inflation uprate the £12570 Personal Allowance in April 2027 or earlier
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779031

Raise the standard tax-free Personal Allowance to £50,000.
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778006
